summary: Iteration 11 — verified NORMS PAUSE (Personality within-person block + EI grade-word removal), C1 JUNCTION CHECK anonymous flow end-to-end, retention cron, and regression PDFs. Backend: /app/tests offline suite 129/129 passed; /app/backend/tests 168/170 passed on the first run (2 transient network timeouts, both passed on retry) → treated as flaky network, not code. New /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11.py adds 12 targeted acceptance tests, all 12 passing: (1) ui.demo /me/sessions lists 4+ complete instruments; every complete result returns 200; individual + combined personality PDFs are byte-identical on repeat; situation flip returns different bytes and flip-back restores the original bytes (snapshot key intact). (2) Personality result carries a `position` block with version wp-1.0.0, floor 1.5, one row per factor whose `sentence` starts with 'Toward the …' or 'Between the …/at your own middle'; NO `commonness` key anywhere in the payload; NONE of {people, population, percentile, unusually, 'about 1 in', 'sten', '/10', 'very high', 'very low'} appear in any sentence. (3) At most three factors flagged `loudest:true` in position.scales; result-level `loudest` ≤ 3; `strengths` and `blind_spots` factor-sets equal the split of `loudest` by direction (backwards compatibility preserved). (4) EI: source of routes/mirror_v2.py::_score_eq contains no {"Moderate","Developing","High",domain_band,overall_band} — scorer is band-free. NOTE: ui.demo's stored EI result is a PRE-PAUSE SNAPSHOT and still carries overall_band/'Moderate'/'High' by design (agent-to-agent note (c): 'older stored results ... intentionally never re-rendered'); this is expected, not a bug. EI PDF still renders (%PDF header). (5) Personality PDF: pdfminer.six extract of the current ui.demo personality PDF contains 'toward the' / 'your own middle' within-person sentences and ZERO of {percentile, '1 in ', very high, very low, unusually common, 'of the population'}. (6) Junction share-payload returns 6 items with 'for somebody else' in first_screen.instruction. (7) A full anonymous junction start→answers→complete round returns a result whose JSON contains NONE of {score, "band", percentage, compatib, aligned, 'traffic light', 'you agree on'}. (8) POST /api/cron/junction-purge → 401 with no bearer AND with a wrong bearer; with the correct WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET (read from /app/backend/.env) → 200 acked. Frontend (Playwright, preview URL): Landing carries data-testid=junction-door AND start-junction-check → /junction; guarantee-line ABSENT; reportable-limits-line PRESENT. The /junction page walks all six items one screen at a time: item 1 (j1) 'yes' triggers the j1b follow-up; item 2 (j2) 'settled' triggers the j2b follow-up. Completion lands on the result screen with junction-written-back, junction-finding, junction-finding-lead, junction-discomfort, junction-closing, junction-share-button (share sub-copy contains the word 'questions'), junction-safety — all present. All 13 marketing/auth routes (/, /junction, /instruments, /archetypes, /promise, /learn, /safety, /faq, /partners, /samples, /methodology, /login, /register) HTTP 200 with substantive body text and ZERO console/page errors. Mobile 390px /junction: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == innerWidth). Personality result page at /results/{sid} for ui.demo renders: personality-title=1, position-explainer=1, why-no-comparison=1, position-version=1, personality-loudest=1, factor-position=15 (one per factor); loudest-none=1 (this demo profile is uniform enough that zero factors clear the 1.5 floor, which is the LOUDEST_N=3 pause spec functioning correctly). ABSENT (as required): factor-commonness=0, commonness-explainer=0, commonness-version=0. Body scan of the personality result page finds ZERO occurrences of {percentile, '1 in ', very high, very low, population, commonness}.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/services/within_person.py — 1.5 sten floor and LOUDEST_N=3 are correctly enforced; a profile with insufficient spread (like ui.demo's) legitimately produces loudest_none, which the UI copes with via the loudest-none testid. Good graceful degradation.

backend/routes/mirror_v2.py — the read-time _position() call and the neutered _commonness() (still wired but returns None) are the right shape: it means DISPLAY_VERSION=disp-1.1.0 flips behaviour without invalidating stored raw scores. Older result snapshots correctly retain their pre-pause `label`/`overall_band` fields because they are never re-rendered; a future cleanup can drop those keys once no rendered PDF still references them.

backend/routes/junction.py — the anonymous flow claim-vs-unclaimed guard ({"$in":[None,user_id]}) inside _claim() is the correct minimum-privilege swap; the second-account test proves it (claimed:0). Consider adding an explicit anonymous_id server cookie to reduce cross-device abuse (currently the browser's localStorage-only id is trust-on-first-use).

backend/routes/cron.py — bearer + constant-time compare + background task with X-Webhook-Id is the right shape. Small suggestion: also log a purge count into a small `cron_runs` collection so ops can verify from data instead of logs, but not blocking.

frontend/src/pages/Junction.js — junction id is stored in localStorage (key rk.junction) and used to resume; correctly cleared on 404. The follow-up render condition (shown_when.includes(answers[item.id]) || shown_when === 'always') is clean.

frontend/src/pages/results/PersonalityResult.js — the three-state (loudest-none / loudest-partial / loudest-list) rendering matches the spec's tiered messaging; a very uniform profile ends up on loudest-none (verified live).

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) /api/auth/me/sessions returns {'sessions': [...]} with rows keyed as {session_id, instrument, status, started_at, completed_at} — NOT id/kind. 2) ui.demo's stored EI result is a PRE-PAUSE snapshot and still contains overall_band/Moderate/High. Per iteration-11 spec (agent-to-agent note c), older snapshots are intentionally never re-rendered — do NOT mark this as a bug. Verify the pause on EI by source-inspection of routes/mirror_v2.py::_score_eq (as test_within_person.py::test_ei_reports_the_score_and_drops_the_grade and test_iteration11.py::test_ei_scorer_source_emits_no_band_words do) or by completing a fresh EI session. 3) ui.demo's personality profile is uniform enough that zero factors clear FLOOR=1.5, so the loudest section legitimately renders loudest-none (testid). This is not a bug — it is the LOUDEST_N=3 spec functioning; to see loudest-list populated you'd need to complete a fresh personality with a spread profile. 4) Junction rate limit is 40/10min per XFF (env RK_RL_JUNCTION); the backend/tests/test_junction.py suite already exercises it once per module. If you re-run repeatedly from the same script origin, either bump the env or wait 10 minutes. 5) pdfminer.six was pip-installed at test-run time to decode reportlab-compressed streams; the personality PDF text scan uses it. 6) Two transient ConnectTimeout errors seen on the FIRST sweep of backend/tests (test_pdf_report.py::test_personality_numbers_match and test_junction.py::test_the_six_questions_are_served_without_an_account) both PASSED on immediate re-run — flaky preview-ingress network, not code.
